quests.title: Poets' Corner
quests.summary: Read the plaques of three English poets where they lived, for the Abbey's tour sheet.

steps.text: Read the plaque about Wordsworth's daffodils by the water in the Lake District.
Read Shakespeare's plaque inside the Globe in London.
Read Jane Austen's blue plaque in Bath.
Report back to the guide in Poets' Corner at Westminster Abbey.

quests.reward: A Pocket Anthology, two flasks of tea and standing in England.

quests.title: Branwen's Starling
quests.summary: Carry a message like Branwen's starling: fetch a copied page of the White Book of Rhydderch from Aberystwyth.

steps.text: Read the board about Branwen in the gatehouse at Harlech.
Ask the Mabinogi scholar at the National Library of Wales in Aberystwyth for a copy of the page.
Bring the page back to the cyfarwydd at Harlech.

quests.reward: The Mabinogion, bara brith and standing in Wales.

quests.title: The Immortal Memory
quests.summary: Learn how Burns died in Dumfries and lived in Edinburgh, then earn the toast at the Burns Supper.

steps.text: Read the board about Burns in Dumfries, by the lochan in Galloway Forest Park.
Read the board about Burns's winter in Edinburgh, near the Royal Mile.
Answer the secretary's question back in Galloway.

quests.reward: A facsimile of the Kilmarnock Edition, tablet and standing in Scotland.

quests.title: Field Day
quests.summary: Gather the Field Day company for a revival of Translations: Heaney's blessing and a wandering actor.

steps.text: Read Seamus Heaney's board on the Bellaghy side of Lough Neagh.
Find the actor in the Craft Village in Derry and send him back.
Report to the stage manager in the Guildhall.

quests.reward: A Field Day programme, soda farls and standing in Northern Ireland.

quests.title: Bloomsday
quests.summary: Fetch Leopold Bloom's lemon soap and gorgonzola sandwich for a Bloomsday rehearsal.

steps.text: Buy a cake of lemon soap from the chemist outside Sweny's.
Get a gorgonzola sandwich from the barman at Davy Byrne's.
Bring both back to the Joycean in the boater.

quests.reward: A straw boater, gorgonzola sandwiches, the soap to keep, and standing in Ireland.
